values: Generated 2026-06-28T18:24:40.614Z. Scope excludes WebGL and Canvas implementation work.
Old AppComponents contains many basic primitives duplicated by BaseLib/Charts.
Button, Card, TextBox, DropDown, Tabs, Chart, DataGrid, ProgressBar and related primitive enums exist in both repositories.
No non-WebGL/non-Canvas test project is present for standard components.
tests/ currently contains only CanDoItAll.Components.WebGlLib.Tests and CanDoItAll.Components.WebGlRunLib.Tests.
Tailwind inputs include a mix of @apply and raw CSS layout/property declarations.
Tailwind/input.css, controls/buttons.css, navigation/tabs.css, foundation/theme.css and forms/tag-editor.css contain substantial raw declarations and token work.
Standard Razor components with no direct sandbox example
Base component inheritance and attribute merging are not universal.
StyledComponentBase centralizes Class, Style, AdditionalAttributes, but support models, compatibility shims, and some wrappers need a deliberate boundary.
Sandbox is grouped, but coverage is sampled rather than one-to-one for every standard component.
SandboxCatalogRegistry defines groups and examples, but many BaseLib components have zero direct example references.
Canvas is still grouped inside the main sandbox registry.
SandboxGroupKey includes Canvas and Examples include canvas preview entries, while this publishing bundle must exclude Canvas/WebGL work.
Some old AppComponents behavior may be newer than BaseLib and must not be deleted blindly.
Old AppComponents Button has an isClickInFlight guard; BaseLib Button adds anchors and compatibility looks but lacks that guard in current inspection.
UI publishing proof must be visual and interactive, not source-only.
Dropdowns, dialogs, tooltips, sticky action footers, tabs, and long-text/dense states require open-state screenshots and browser assertions.
